name: 3D stickman
description: A true 3D stickman: glossy ink-black articulated body with real joints, white gloves and shoes, a coloured scarf and a big expressive face, acting in a bright airy loft. 'What if', survival and life-story explainers.
rules: The body is the acting: every beat has a full-body pose from the gesture library, joints visible.
Ink-black glossy body, white gloves/shoes, ONE accent colour (the scarf) that matches the caption highlight.
Bright high-key room with soft shadows; keep exposure at or below 0.9 so the white gloves do not clip.
Face: big white eyes with moving pupils, brows, a smile arc or an open mouth; blink every 3 s.
Feet are planted on the floor with a real shadow; the figure never floats.
Captions: bold white with a dark outline, one accent word.
camera_language: Wide to show the whole body acting (the silhouette is the performance); medium for talking; close-up on the face for the joke or the reaction. The camera stays low-key: moves are rare and each one is a reveal.
audio_direction: bed, boing/pop on gags, thud on falls
pitfalls: Ball joints stack at the hips in wide poses: keep legs at least 18 degrees apart.
Over-the-shoulder crops the head: acceptable, but keep the hand and the object in the lower two thirds.
High-key lighting hazes distant shots: lower exposure and raise vignette.
